# Code Anchors: Epic Coverage Run

- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/coverage.ts` — the four coverage states over the epic's live story set, read from the records
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/coverage.spec.ts` — pins unrecorded apart from unshipped, the excluded story, and a story added after a record was written
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/story-prs.ts` — the complete-or-failed read of each story's claiming pull requests
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/story-prs.spec.ts` — pins paging to the last page and the failure that names the story
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/diagnostic.ts` — the failed-story-read diagnostic, naming every failed story and its cause
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the coverage verb, which exits with an error and prints no coverage on a failed read
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the stage contract that reports the diagnostic verbatim and never reports a failed story as unshipped
- `utils/close-epic.sh` — stops before close when the coverage run exits with an error
